title: Set 200

sentences.ko: 나 기타에 완전 빠졌던 거 기억나? 한 달 정도 매일 밤 연습했는데, 손가락 끝이 아파서 일주일만 쉬자 했거든. 근데 어쩌다 보니 그 일주일이 1년이 됐어.
sentences.text: Remember when I got really into guitar? I practiced every night for like a month, but then my fingertips started hurting, so I took a week off, and somehow that week turned into a year.

alts.text: You remember my whole guitar thing? I played every single night for like a month, then my fingertips started killing me, so I took a week off, and somehow that week turned into a year.

Do you remember when I became very interested in the guitar? I practiced every evening for about a month, but then my fingertips began to hurt, so I took a week off, and somehow that week became a year.

sentences.note: **got really into** 는 무언가에 푹 빠졌다는 말이에요. **took a week off** 는 일주일 쉬었다는 뜻이고, **turned into** 는 어느새 다른 것으로 바뀌어 버렸다는 느낌이에요.

sentences.ko: 안녕하세요, 부엌 수도꼭지에서 물이 샌 지 한 2주 됐어요. 제가 직접 조여 보려고 했는데 오히려 더 망가뜨린 것 같아요. 혹시 이번 주에 사람 좀 보내 주실 수 있을까요? 제가 집에 없으면 옆집에 열쇠 맡겨 둘게요.
sentences.text: Hi, so the kitchen faucet's been dripping for about two weeks now. I tried tightening it myself, but I think I just made it worse. Is there any way you could send somebody this week? I can leave a key with my neighbor if I'm not home.

alts.text: Hey, the kitchen faucet's been dripping for like two weeks. I tried tightening it, but I think I made it worse. Could you maybe get somebody out here this week? If I'm not around, I can leave a key with my neighbor.

Hello, the kitchen faucet has been dripping for approximately two weeks. I attempted to tighten it myself, but I believe I have made it worse. Would it be possible to send someone this week? If I am not at home, I can leave a key with my neighbor.

sentences.note: **Is there any way you could** 는 혹시 ~해 주실 수 있을까요 하고 공손하게 부탁하는 말이에요. **made it worse** 는 오히려 더 나빠지게 만들었다는 뜻이에요.
sentences.situation: 집주인이랑 고장 난 것 고쳐 달라고 얘기하기

sentences.ko: 인터넷으로 폰 케이스를 시켰는데, 와 보니까 완전 다른 폰 케이스인 거야. 근데 반품 배송비가 케이스 값보다 더 비싸. 그럼 그냥 내가 갖고 있어야 하나 봐?
sentences.text: So I ordered a phone case online, and what showed up was a case for a totally different phone. And the return label costs more than the case did, so I guess I'm just keeping it?

alts.text: Okay, I got a phone case online and they sent me one for a totally different phone. Sending it back costs more than the case did, so I guess I'm stuck with it?
I ordered a phone case online, and the one that arrived was for an entirely different phone. Since the return label costs more than the case itself, I suppose I will simply have to keep it.

sentences.note: **what showed up was** 는 막상 도착한 건 ~였다는 말이에요. casual 의 **I'm stuck with it** 은 어쩔 수 없이 떠안게 됐다는 느낌이에요.
sentences.situation: 배달 시켰는데 엉뚱한 게 와서 얘기하기

sentences.ko: 부모님이 연세가 드시니까 마음 한편으로는 가까이 이사 가고 싶어. 근데 친구들이 다 여기 있잖아. 가서 외로워지면 괜히 부모님을 원망하게 될까 봐 좀 걱정돼.
sentences.text: Part of me really wants to move closer to my parents now that they're getting older, but all my friends are here, and I'm kind of worried I'd end up lonely and resent my parents for it.

alts.text: I kinda wanna move closer to my parents now that they're getting older, but all my friends are here, and I'm worried I'd get lonely and end up resenting them for it.

Part of me would very much like to move closer to my parents now that they are getting older, but all of my friends are here, and I am somewhat concerned that I would become lonely and resent my parents for it.

sentences.note: **Part of me** 는 마음 한편으로는 이라는 뜻이에요. **now that** 은 이제 ~하니까, **end up** 은 결국 ~하게 되다는 말이에요.

sentences.ko: 미안, 미안! 알람이 안 울렸어. 아니, 울리긴 했는데 자면서 꺼 버렸나 봐. 진짜 하나도 기억이 안 나거든.
sentences.text: Sorry, sorry! My alarm didn't go off. Well, okay, it did go off, but I must've turned it off in my sleep, because I honestly don't remember it at all.

alts.text: Ugh, sorry! Alarm didn't go off. I mean, it did, but I must've shut it off in my sleep, 'cause I seriously don't remember.
I apologize! My alarm did not go off. Actually, it did go off, but I must have turned it off while I was asleep, because I genuinely do not remember it at all.

sentences.note: **go off** 는 알람이 울린다는 말이에요. **must've turned it off** 는 꺼 버렸던 게 분명하다는 추측이에요. **in my sleep** 은 자는 사이에 라는 뜻이에요.

reviewed: 3번 한국어 '그냥 쓰라는 거겠지?'는 판매자 뜻을 짐작하는 말이라 영어 'I guess I'm just keeping it?'(그냥 내가 갖고 있어야 하나 봐?)과 뜻이 달라서 고침
3번 formal이 물음의 어정쩡한 말투를 단정으로 바꿔 버려서, 뜻이 같게 'I suppose I will simply have to keep it'으로 고침
4번 casual의 'I kinda really wanna'는 kinda와 really가 서로 부딪혀 어색해서 'I kinda wanna'로 줄임
4번 한국어에 'Part of me'(마음 한편으로는)가 빠져 있어서 넣음
5번 casual 앞부분 'My alarm didn't go off. Okay, it did'가 text와 거의 같아서 더 짧은 구어로 바꿈
